KEANO Zinnia Princess Girls' Bike - Sizes 14" to 20"
Let your little princess ride in style with the KEANO Zinnia Princess Girls' Bike. Featuring a charming design and delightful accessories, this princess style children's bicycle is specifically engineered for girls to build confidence, stability, and pure joy on two wheels. It's the perfect first bike for girls seeking neighborhood adventures.

The perfect princess ride: KEANO Zinnia girls bike with training wheels, classic woven basket, and a cozy rear doll seat.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Designed for maximum sidewalk enjoyment, the KEANO Zinnia features a robust frame, adjustable components, and reliable braking systems to safely grow alongside your child."
Safer Riding Features
The KEANO Zinnia is built with a heavy-duty, rigid carbon steel frame designed to withstand the tumbles of learning how to ride. This kids bicycle features an intuitive rear coaster brake that delivers smooth, reliable foot-power stopping whenever they pedal backward. Coupled with extra-wide 2.125" pneumatic tires, your young cyclist will enjoy superior road grip and excellent balance on all paths.

Smooth pedaling and stable handling provide unmatched protection for confident first-time riders.

Child-Friendly Protection & Comfort

Intuitive Braking: Easy-to-use rear coaster/foot brake offers responsive stopping power designed for small feet.

Full Protection: A completely enclosed chain guard keeps shoelaces, clothing, and small fingers safe from moving drivetrain parts.

Growth Adjustments: The adjustable seat height and adjustable stem height allow this bicycle to seamlessly adjust as your child sprouts.

High Visibility: Integrated front, rear, and wheel reflectors ensure your child remains clearly visible during early morning or sunset rides.

Quick & Easy Assembly
We know you want to get your little adventurer out on the sidewalk fast. The KEANO Zinnia arrives **85% pre-assembled** right out of the box. All required specialty assembly tools and easy-to-follow guidelines are packaged with the bike. You can completely finish attaching the front wheel, handlebars, pedals, and accessories in roughly **20 minutes**.

Our Guarantee
Your investment is fully protected by a Limited Lifetime Manufacturer Warranty on the rigid carbon steel frame. To ensure complete confidence in your purchase, we also pass along a comprehensive FREE 30-day refund or replacement policy if you are not fully satisfied with your riding experience.
